content: Screening for Posttransplantation Diabetes Mellitus (PTDM) should be conducted once the patient has achieved a stable condition following the transplant procedure. The oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) is the recommended diagnostic method for identifying PTDM. When designing immunosuppressive therapy regimens, the primary focus should be on optimizing both graft function and overall patient outcomes, even if there is an associated risk of developing PTDM.
